task: epitope ranking: the peptide varies, the receptor and MHC are held fixed

components.name: energy
components.definition: structural poly-alanine reference difference on the TCR:peptide interface, epitope positions truncated to alanine in 3D with the contact map rebuilt

components.name: confidence
components.definition: generator interface pTM, supplied by the caller; tcren does not compute it

standardization: means and scales frozen on a held-out training pool of 729 models over 14 off-panel epitopes; no label was read, so this is a change of units and not a fit
combination: equal-weight mean of the standardized, direction-corrected components
